corrections.why: That page and firelookout.com's Jungle Point camp page describe a 1930 camp abandoned in 1942, 13 miles SSE of Grangeville, at 5,851 feet on the Nez Perce National Forest. It is not the Clearwater tower this record describes.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two Jungle Point lookouts are listed in Idaho County. The Clearwater National Forest tower (4,000 feet, 14 miles east-northeast of Kooskia) is the subject here. The Nez Perce camp (5,851 feet, 13 miles south-southeast of Grangeville) is a different site. The sources do not disagree about the tower; the record joined the two.

notes_for_editor: Location check needed. The record's point (46.20038, -115.68538) is about 10 km south of the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Idaho list entry for this tower (46.28971, -115.67174). The record's point was taken from the Idaho Fire Lookouts page, which has no coordinates of its own. Please check the pin. Dates are only given as the 1930s, so no year-level events are recorded. No source documents staffing, so the story has no staffing paragraph. The record currently links the Nez Perce camp page as if it were this tower; see corrections.
